services.desc: Dolphin Tours are conducted on our luxury pontoon boats with your own captain and guide who will drive you to the mouth of the Homosassa River in search of dolphins. The dolphin often swim up river in search of food so we may see them at any point on our way to the Gulf. Our guides will share their knowledge of Homosassa’s history and ecosystem with you pointing out interesting landmarks from our historic town. Ecological tours by boat offer you the opportunity to see animals, fauna and flora unaccessible from the mainland. blurb: Guests can enjoy private or shared airboat tours lasting 60 or 90 minutes exploring nature where other boats can't go. Pontoon boat rentals are available for half or full day to cruise to Homosassa Springs and visit waterfront restaurants. Boat tours include manatee tours, dolphin tours, eco tours, and custom tours along the Homosassa River and Gulf of Mexico.
